rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an airport runway.

example.english: The plane is about to land, so don't go near the runway.
example.traditional: 架飛機就快降落喇，唔好行近跑道。
example.jyutping: gaa3 fei1 gei1 zau6 faai3 gong3 lok6 laa3 m4 hou2 haang4 gan6 paau2 dou6

rows.note: Use this for the catwalk where fashion models walk, not for an airport runway.

example.english: The runway at this fashion show is very impressive.
example.traditional: 呢場時裝騷嘅天橋好有氣勢。
example.jyutping: ni1 coeng4 si4 zong1 sou1 ge3 tin1 kiu4 hou2 jau5 hei3 sai3
